implementation: New optional ROS 2 bridge; only high-level Move and StopMove
differences_from_v4: Separate ROS publisher instead of directly instantiating the Unitree C++ SDK.
No standing, crouching, mode switching, or low-level motor methods.
Explicit g arm requires acknowledged StopMove; h supplies attended terminal deadman.
Freshness checks require P9 live guard status in addition to robot telemetry.

test_status.ROS_loopback_mock: Script uses loopback lo/domain101, including SIGHUP and closed PTY while forwarding; execution recorded separately by release builder.

terminal_cleanup.scope: Pure Python cleanup ordering and real PTY hangup; no ROS or hardware.

schema_validation.required_schemas: All 8 unitree_api .msg files plus SportModeState, TimeSpec and IMUState byte-identical to previously inspected autonomy_stack_go2 copy.
schema_validation.v4_comparison_scope: Previously inspected v4 source and recorded data field/API semantics; no new v4 generated schema extraction.

test_configuration_change: DDS domain corrected from239 to101 because239 produced RTPS ports above65535; no control-policy change.
shutdown_fix: StopMove is attempted before nonblocking terminal restore; nested finally releases ROS resources even when terminal restoration fails. Broken terminal output cannot interrupt stop retries.
